d:
Ja Morant speaks on the 4th quarter takeover he and Damian Lillard led in Los Angeles as the Trail Blazers beat the Lakers, 136-129, to move to 3-0!
Morant finished with 23 points and 4 assists, tying Deni Avdija for the team high. Avdija added 23 points on 8-for-15 shooting, including 4-for-7 from three, along with 9 assists. For the Lakers, Luka Dončić had 41 points and 9 assists in the loss as Los Angeles fell to 3-1.
Hear from Morant on how Portland closed it out.
